# Sample books for the smoke test and for screenshots. Not published.

title: Chaos: Making a New Science
author: James Gleick
read: 2026-08-14
favourite: yes
cover: chaos.svg
note: lorenz-attractor

Sample review. The book that made the butterfly effect a household phrase:
Lorenz's weather model, Feigenbaum's constants and Mandelbrot's coastlines,
told through the people who found them.

It links to an entry in this library: [[sensitive-dependence]].

---

title: The Essence of Chaos
author: Edward N. Lorenz
read: 2026-06-02
favourite: yes
cover: essence.svg
link: https://uwapress.uw.edu/book/9780295975146/the-essence-of-chaos/

Sample review. Lorenz's own account, written for a general reader, of what
chaos is and of the model that bears his name.
